question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
-- Split toppings and join with pizza_toppings
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT c.order_id, c.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders c
    INNER JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders ro ON c.order_id = ro.order_id
    WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL
),
order_toppings AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, d.pizza_id, r.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders d
    INNER JOIN pizza_recipes r ON d.pizza_id = r.pizza_id
),
split_toppings AS (
    SELECT order_id, 
           TRIM(SPLIT_PART(toppings, ',', seq))::INTEGER AS topping_id
    FROM order_toppings,
         UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LEN(toppings) - LEN(REPLACE(toppings, ',', '')) + 1)) AS seq(seq)
)
SELECT st.topping_id, pt.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS quantity
FROM split_toppings st
INNER JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON st.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY st.topping_id, pt.topping_name
ORDER BY quantity DESC
